desc: The map editor ($TTYD_MAPEDIT_TEST): opened as the Start menu's row opens it, a click on the room places a pipe by the ray, a controller's Y and A a Save Block, Page Up, F, R, the arrows, LB, Delete, Ctrl+Z, Backspace, Tab and Back for test play, Ctrl+S saves the mod, Esc closes; Start pressed while it edits opens nothing (in test play it opens the Start menu)

\[mapedit test\] Y then A .*things 2, palette save_block, picked save_block
\[mapedit test\] F \(down on the floor, a block 60 above it\): .*picked save_block at -?\d+ 60
\[mapedit test\] Tab \(test play; not fast-forward\): on 1, test 1
\[mapedit test\] Back \(test play; not the settings page\): on 1, test 1
